source: Vanlightly/s3-wal-collection @ 35fdc537af4d226f43b4574cded1764375f264ac, released SlateDBWAL.tla with its six invariants and writer/value symmetry. Medium disables restarts; TwoRetry restores one. Fixed and switch differ only at EnableFix. The four-writer variant also extends Writers by w4.
machine: Dedicated AWS r7i.8xlarge, us-east-2, 16 logical CPUs 0–15, single fresh process per run. GNU time wall seconds and maximum RSS in KiB. Each data point is one run.
command: taskset -c 0-15 dive check spec/SlateDBWAL.tla --config EDITED.cfg --library-path modules --workers 16 --store exact --time-limit SECONDS --max-memory 212g --seed 0 --fp 0 --output json
validation: dive validate-trace spec/SlateDBWAL.tla --config EDITED.cfg --library-path modules --trace saved.json --fp 0 --seed 0 --output json. The validator checks the concrete predicates and Next steps; its notes list parameterized display labels.
